sources.locator: DBV pin6 VDD and local bypass guidance

requirements.description: Bind TPS3808G33DBVR and suitable 0402 bypass; preserve exact managed footprints, capacitor decoupling role and consumer positive-pad bound. Confirm capacitance, voltage rating and effective capacitance for actual rail.
Host owns IC ground pin 2, signals and complete local return loop. Connect IC ground locally to continuous ground planes; macro owns only capacitor ground lead/via.
Require full consumer native filled-board DRC, surface bypass verification, plane connectivity and assembly review. Do not route other load or switch current through this local bypass branch.
SENSE/MR/CT/reset wiring and startup qualification; source PDF binary capture/hash and assembly review remain open.
